# Datalay

> Senior Linux engineering across Europe. Reliable infrastructure, private AI, and secure integration — shaped around how each organisation works.

Datalay Soluciones Informáticas S.L. is a Spanish infrastructure company (since 2003) working remotely with organisations in Spain and across Europe.

## Site

- [Home](https://www.datalay.com/): Overview and ways of working
- [Services](https://www.datalay.com/services/): Linux systems, networks, resilience, security, automation, private AI
- [How we work](https://www.datalay.com/how-we-work/): Engagement model and collaboration
- [Company](https://www.datalay.com/company/): About Datalay
- [Contact](https://www.datalay.com/contact/): Start a conversation — datalay@datalay.com
